name: znetwork_init_session_runtime
description: zNetwork::InitSessionRuntime initializes DirectPlay session runtime containers and the packet-1 color assignment handler.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

Binary Ninja reconstruction remains limited because VC exception scaffolding and uninitialized container flag-byte writes obscure the original high-level container construction; assembly validates the runtime global and list/vector initialization behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/HLIL for 0x489d00 validates the fastcall appGuid argument, fatal-disconnect callback and receive-buffer reset before DirectPlay setup, successful CreateInterfaceAndCoInitialize path setting session-runtime initialized, fatal-disconnect triggered flag, app GUID, DirectPlay pointer, current session cache, local player record, and deleting existing dispatch handlers, then ensuring the enumerated-session archive list exists, allocating an empty player-record list with a self-linked sentinel and count 0, allocating an empty service-provider vector with begin/end/cap set to null, registering packet type 1 to zNetwork_ApplyPkt01_PlayerColorAssignments with mode 2, and returning 0.

Native smoke znetwork_init_session_runtime_smoke patches zNetwork_DPlay::CreateInterfaceAndCoInitialize and verifies both successful and failing HRESULT paths, including success-only runtime global updates, failure-preserved runtime globals, unconditional fatal callback/receive buffer reset, container allocation, dispatch-handler deletion on success, dispatch-handler preservation on failure, and packet-1 handler registration.
